path: ForwardFluxOperator.flux_map -> ForwardFluxOperator.read -> Topology.read -> Null2D.interpolate -> select.traced_subnull -> select.traced_quadratic_surface -> jax.numpy.linalg.lstsq -> SVD JVP
first_nonfinite_primitive: division in the JAX SVD JVP invoked by jax.numpy.linalg.lstsq
originating_operation: the quadratic surface fit used to interpolate magnetic-axis and X-point nulls
mechanism: The local quadratic design matrix depends only on grid geometry, but it was carried as a differentiable pytree leaf into lstsq. Symmetric stencils give that matrix repeated singular values. The SVD singular-vector derivative divides by a zero singular-value gap even though the geometry tangent is zero, and the resulting non-finite tangent contaminates every entry of the flux-map action.
repair: ForwardFluxOperator now uses a topology locator whose immutable quadratic design pseudoinverse is computed once on the host. Its device fit is a matrix action, so linearization differentiates the sampled flux while preserving the same fixed-shape null categorization, stationary-point reconstruction, and topology read.

banked_diagnostic_regression.meaning: the banked pre-repair diagnostic receipt remains internally consistent
